fullStack.title: FullStack development
fullStack.description: Building complete and maintainable web applications. Developing reactive interfaces in React, Vue 3, and Angular, backed by robust services in Node.js, NestJS, and Python, with optimized databases and clean architectures.

mobile.title: Mobile development
mobile.description: Creating smooth and cross-platform applications with Flutter, complemented by native development in Kotlin. I apply design patterns such as BLOC and principles of Clean Architecture to ensure stability and efficient persistence.

design.title: From design to deployment
design.description: A comprehensive approach to the product lifecycle: interactive prototyping in Figma under accessibility criteria (WCAG), agile workflows (Scrum / Kanban), and continuous deployment in the cloud with AWS and Docker services.
